hints.title: State Representation
hints.text: State consists of current position and a boolean flag indicating if the previous jump was backward.

hints.title: Upper Bound Bounding
hints.text: Do not explore positions beyond max(x, max(forbidden)) + a + b (roughly 6000).

hints.title: Breadth-First Exploration
hints.text: Enqueue forward jump (position + a, false) and, if previous was not backward, backward jump (position - b, true).

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded exploration could loop endlessly without upper position bounding.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Visited set tracking (position, can_jump_back) guarantees each state is visited once in O(LIMIT).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should determine reasonable upper limit and avoid consecutive backward jumps.
